features.feature3: Continuous scrolling news feed for seamless consumption.

features.feature1: Chronological news timeline.

feature5.heading: #Feature 5
feature5.desc: Enables users to change the app language seamlessly, allowing them to consume news in their preferred regional or global language for better accessibility and understanding.

features.feature1: Multiple language options.
features.feature2: One-tap language update.
features.feature3: Localized news experience.

feature6.heading: #Feature 6
feature6.desc: Allows users to explore news intelligently using search, voice input, filters, tags, and location-based options to quickly discover relevant and latest stories.

features.feature1: Keyword and voice search.
features.feature2: Category, sort, and location filters.
features.feature3: Trending tags exploration.

feature7.heading: #Feature 7
feature7.desc: Shows a curated list of recommended news articles based on user interests and engagement, with support for video-only filtering and quick discovery through search.

features.feature1: Interest-based recommendations.
features.feature2: Videos-only content filter.
features.feature3: Integrated search access.

feature8.heading: #Feature 8
feature8.desc: Provides a clean and immersive news reading experience with a featured image, category tag, engagement metrics, author details, and full article content optimized for mobile users.

features.feature1: Large featured image banner for strong visual impact.
features.feature2: Category-wise labeling (e.g., Bollywood News).
features.feature3: Engagement metrics including views and comments count.
features.feature4: Author name and publish date visibility.
features.feature5: Social sharing and report news options.
features.feature6: Readable typography with distraction-free content layout.
features.feature7: Support for comments and user interaction.

feature9.heading: #Feature 9
feature9.subHeading: News Article with Embedded Video & Source Options
feature9.desc: Enables rich news storytelling by embedding official videos (such as trailers) directly within articles, along with source attribution and enhanced engagement controls.

features.feature1: Embedded YouTube video support inside news articles.
features.feature2: One-tap option to view the video directly on YouTube.
features.feature3: Visit source link for original content attribution.

feature10.heading: #Featur10
feature10.subHeading: Smart Feedback System with Integrated Social Sharing & Ad Slots
feature10.desc: Boost user retention and monetization with a dedicated engagement section for every post. This feature combines social virality tools with a seamless feedback loop to keep your community active.

features.feature1: One-Tap Social Sharing: High-visibility social triggers (Facebook, X, WhatsApp) to drive organic traffic back to your platform.
features.feature2: Professional Feedback Loop: A clean, validated comment system allowing users to share insights, fostering a sense of community around your content.
features.feature3: Strategic Ad Placement: Built-in native ad slots above and below engagement zones to maximize click-through rates (CTR) without disrupting user experience.

feature11.heading: #Feature 11
feature11.desc: Shows comments inside a swipe-up bottom sheet modal news app, improving readability and interaction during product preview demos.

features.feature1: Slide-up bottom sheet modal for viewing comments.
features.feature2: Close button (X) at top-right for quick dismiss.
features.feature3: Comment count display at top of article.

feature12.heading: #Feature 12
feature12.subHeading: Seamless YouTube Sync & Real-Time Content Streaming
feature12.desc: Empower your platform with deep YouTube integration. This feature allows users to sync their entire YouTube presence—including Live streams, Shorts, and Playlists—directly into your application for a unified viewing experience.

features.feature1: Real-Time Channel Sync: Automatically fetch and display channel banners, bios, and subscriber counts via official YouTube APIs.
features.feature2: Unified Content Hub: Categorized browsing for VODs, Shorts, and Live events, maintaining the familiar UI/UX that users already love.
features.feature3: One-Tap Engagement: Integrated 'Subscribe' and 'Share' functionalities that bridge the gap between your platform and the YouTube ecosystem.

feature13.heading: #Feature 13
feature13.subHeading: Real-App Ratio, Top Bar, LIVE Badge & Action Controls
feature13.desc: Renders the product preview inside a full LIVE-app style layout including top status bar spacing, LIVE indicator, share & refresh actions, channel header section, and content placeholders with proper app ratio.

features.feature1: Top status bar spacing matching real LIVE app UI.
features.feature2: LIVE badge with dot indicator in header.
features.feature3: Quick actions: refresh, share and back navigation.

feature14.heading: #Featur14
feature14.subHeading: Immersive Shorts News Module and Frictionless Content
feature14.desc: A dynamic media engine that transforms long-form news into byte-sized, multi-sensory experiences. This feature is designed to reduce churn and maximize user session time through innovative interaction tools.

features.feature1: On-Demand News Narration: Integrated text-to-speech engine lets users 'listen' to the news, making content accessible during multitasking.
features.feature2: Geo-Tagged Local Context: Deep location awareness allows users to instantly view the geographical context of a news story with a single tap.
features.feature3: Integrated Viral Growth Toolkit: Frictionless social sharing (WhatsApp direct) and feedback loops (claps, bookmarks) to drive organic platform growth.

feature15.heading: #Feature 15
feature15.subHeading: Search Box, Location List & Apply Controls
feature15.desc: Shows a location filter overlay with a search input, selectable location options, and quick action buttons to apply or clear the filter, matching the app preview design.

features.feature1: Header title 'Select Location' with close (X) button.
features.feature2: Search input box with placeholder 'Search location…'.
features.feature3: Selectable location list with radio buttons.

feature16.heading: #Feature 16
feature16.subHeading: Vote Stats with Party List & Status Footer
feature16.desc: Displays poll results with party options, vote percentage bars, and poll status indicators in a clean preview layout.

features.feature1: Party-wise vote percentage progress bars.
features.feature2: User poll status badges (Already voted, Expired, Expired timer).
features.feature3: Footer actions for reporting and sharing poll.

feature17.heading: #Featur17
feature17.subHeading: Filter Polls by Date, Votes & Status
feature17.desc: Allows users to filter election polls based on date, popularity, creator and vote participation status.

features.feature1: Filter by poll date (Active or Expired).
features.feature2: Sort polls by votes (Most voted or Least voted).
features.feature3: Filter by user vote status (All, Voted, Not voted).

feature18.heading: #Featur18
feature18.subHeading: Election Poll Result Analytics Seat Count, Party Stats & Key Candidates
feature18.desc: Shows election poll result with total seats, party-wise distribution chart, target seats, candidate results, and quick actions.

features.feature1: Total seat count with party-wise breakdown.
features.feature2: Donut chart for seat distribution and target seat indicator.
features.feature3: Key candidates list with win status and party symbols.

feature19.heading: #Featur19
feature19.subHeading: Marketplace Ads Corner Seller & Buyer Mode with Promoted Ads
feature19.desc: Displays promoted marketplace ads with pricing, seller/buyer toggle, location tag, and support access.

features.feature1: Toggle between Seller and Buyer modes.
features.feature2: Showcase promoted ads with price and sponsor details.
features.feature3: Quick access to location-based ads and support.

feature20.heading: #Featur20
feature20.subHeading: Marketplace Ad Service Details & Contact Access
feature20.desc: Showcases ad card with service overview, pricing, gallery preview, and multiple contact channels.

features.feature1: Service title and price display with business summary.
features.feature2: Image gallery preview slider for ad showcase.
features.feature3: Direct contact options including Phone, Email, Website, and WhatsApp.

feature21.heading: #Featur21
feature21.desc: Lets sellers submit what they want to sell using a structured query form or connect instantly via WhatsApp.

features.feature1: Seller query input box with 100-character limit.
features.feature2: Seller identity fields: Name and Contact Number.
features.feature3: Product/Service description box with 200-character limit.

feature22.heading: #Feature 22

feature22.desc: Enables buyers to submit product purchase requirements using a structured query form or connect instantly via WhatsApp support.

features.feature1: Search query input box with 100 character limit.
features.feature2: User identity fields including Name and Contact Number.
features.feature3: Description box with 200 character limit for detailed requirements.
